rule: The honest source count is distinct datasets, not plugin files. Plugins that read files of one published dataset (one product of one publisher) share an entry below; a plugin not listed is its own dataset, named by its SOURCE name and publisher. Geography helpers (`geo`) and the Kodros listings collector (`not_counted`) never count. Collected counts: a dataset counts toward each side (residential, commercial) one of its plugins sits on, so the two sides can add up to more than the total. A dataset or publisher takes the best status of its plugins (ok, then stale, needs_key, unavailable). The number reported to the owner is datasets used (see used_rule).

used_rule.text: Main 2026-11-14: a loaded dataset counts toward a side only if that side uses it: at least one of its fields is a member of one of that side's metrics, an input of one of that side's scores (or of the rental grade, residential), or a catalog field shown on the ZIP sheet (fields.json shown has zip) whose catalog group belongs to that side. A metric, derived field or normalizer input that a used key depends on is used too. The plugin's SOURCE side is a hint, not the count. A loaded dataset with a plugin on a side that the side does not use is listed as collected, not used.
